decisionReasons: existing customer with a support question

consent.reason: EU: ask for consent before personal data

questionnaire.question: Is your organisation certified to ISO 27001?
questionnaire.answer: Northwind Ledger is certified to ISO 27001:2022 by an accredited certification body; the certificate covers the production platform and support operations.
reasons: every sentence supported by in-date, approved evidence

questionnaire.question: In which countries is customer data stored, including backups?
questionnaire.answer: Production data is hosted in AWS eu-central-1 in Frankfurt with backups in AWS eu-west-1 in Dublin; no customer data is stored outside the European Union.
reasons: every sentence supported by in-date, approved evidence

questionnaire.question: When was the last independent penetration test of the web application?
List all subprocessors that process customer personal data.
questionnaire.answer: Subprocessors are AWS for hosting, Zendesk for support tickets and Anthropic for AI invoice coding; customers are notified 30 days before a new subprocessor is added.
reasons: every sentence supported by in-date, approved evidence

questionnaire.question: Is customer data used to train AI models?
questionnaire.answer: Customer data is not used to train AI models; prompts sent for AI invoice coding are not retained by the model provider beyond 30 days.
reasons: every sentence supported by in-date, approved evidence

questionnaire.question: When is customer data deleted after the contract ends?
reasons: ev-retention-draft is not approved for customers

questionnaire.question: Do you hold a BSI C5 attestation?
reasons: model did not draft an answer

questionnaire.question: State your recovery time objective and recovery point objective.
questionnaire.answer: Backups run every 24 hours and are kept for 35 days; the recovery time objective is 8 hours and the recovery point objective is 24 hours.
reasons: every sentence supported by in-date, approved evidence
